param.name: targetPosition
param.comment: Sector and point to centre a new slot on

param.name: targetObject
param.comment: Station or gate to centre a new slot on, overrides targetPosition

param.name: targetAdd
param.comment: Set by the context action: open the config window for the target, then reset

location.condition: if @$placingPosition != null and @$placingSector.exists then true else false

set_value.name: $uidPad
set_value.exact: if $uidN lt 10 then '00000' else if $uidN lt 100 then '0000' else if $uidN lt 1000 then '000' else if $uidN lt 10000 then '00' else if $uidN lt 100000 then '0' else ''

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s listed slot %s, which has no entry, removed'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $claimUid]
'SmartMinelayer: %s slot %s reached its threshold, %s of %s missing'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $chkEntry.$uid, $chkEntry.$missing.count, $chkEntry.$positions.count]

do_if.value: typeof $cutEntry == datatype.table and ($cutCollect or $cutEntry.$scan?) and $cutEntry.$items.keys.count gt 0
$collectItem.exists and $collectItem.macro == $deployableMacro and not ($collectSkip.{$collectItem}? and $collectSkip.{$collectItem} gt player.age)

not $collectClaimer or $collectClaimer == this.assignedcontrolled or not @$collectClaimer.isoperational or (@$collectClaimer.defaultorder.id != 'SmartMinelayer' and @$collectClaimer.defaultorder.id != 'Assist')

set_value.name: $retLocOk
set_value.exact: if @$retLoc.isoperational and $retLoc.isclass.station and $retLoc.dockingallowed.{this.assignedcontrolled} and @$retLoc.dock.{this.assignedcontrolled.docksize} and $retLoc.canbuildequipment.{[$retWare]} and this.assignedcontrolled.sector.gatedistance.{$retLoc.sector}.{blacklistgroup.military}.{this.assignedcontrolled} ge 0 then true else false

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s returned %s of %s to %s as build inputs %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $retLocAmount, $retMacro, $retStation.debugname, $retAdded]

'SmartMinelayer: %s sold %s of %s to %s for %s Cr, player received %s Cr'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $retLocAmount, $retMacro, $retStation.debugname, $retPrice / 1Cr, (player.money - $retPlayerMoney) / 1Cr]
'SmartMinelayer: %s keeps %s of %s, %s does not take it'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $retAmount, $retMacro, $retStation.debugname]

do_if.value: $claimItem.exists and $claimItem.macro == $deployableMacro and not ($collectSkip.{$claimItem}? and $collectSkip.{$claimItem} gt player.age)
not $claimer or $claimer == this.assignedcontrolled or not @$claimer.isoperational or (@$claimer.defaultorder.id != 'SmartMinelayer' and @$claimer.defaultorder.id != 'Assist')

set_value.name: $restockLocWhy
set_value.exact: 'not operational or no dock for this ship'

set_value.name: $restockLocOk
set_value.exact: if @$restockLoc.isoperational and $restockLoc != this.assignedcontrolled and $restockLoc.dockingallowed.{this.assignedcontrolled} and @$restockLoc.dock.{this.assignedcontrolled.docksize} then true else false

set_value.name: $restockLocWhy
set_value.exact: 'cannot build it or out of reach'

set_value.name: $restockLocOk
set_value.exact: if $restockLoc.canbuildequipment.{[$restockWare]} and this.assignedcontrolled.sector.gatedistance.{$restockLoc.sector}.{blacklistgroup.military}.{this.assignedcontrolled} ge 0 then true else false

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s config cancelled, slots %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, @this.$SmartMinelayerSlotIds.count]
'SmartMinelayer: %s config ready, op %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, @this.$SmartMinelayerConfigOp.$op]
'SmartMinelayer: %s lost %s at position %s of slot %s, %s missing'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, event.param.debugname, $destroyedK, $destroyedUid, $chkEntry.$missing.count]
'SmartMinelayer: %s cleared the state of removed subordinate %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, event.param.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s took back its stale claim on position %s of slot %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $reqK, $initUid]

'SmartMinelayer: %s order start, target sector %s, add %s, slots %s, wingman %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, @$targetSector.debugname, $targetAdd, $slotIds.count, @this.assignedcontrolled.commander != null]
'SmartMinelayer: %s restock try cut short by an edit, not counted, %s left'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, 5 - this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]
'SmartMinelayer: %s restock try %s cut short by a restart, counted, %s left'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries, 5 - this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]
'SmartMinelayer: %s has no slots and no target, standing by'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s has no slots configured, opening the config window for the first one'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s cannot reach %s past the military blacklist'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $targetSector.debugname]

set_value.name: this.$SmartMinelayerConfigRequestData
set_value.exact: table[ $callbackObject = this.assignedcontrolled, $fromConfigure = false, $sector = $targetSector, $targetPosition = @$targetPosition, $targetObject = if @$targetObject.exists then $targetObject else null, $targetObjectPosition = @$objectPosition, $targetObjectRotation = @$objectRotation, $equipmentStations = $possibleStations, $slots = $requestSlots]

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s requested the config window for %s, slots %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $targetSector.debugname, $slotIds.count]
'SmartMinelayer: %s config cancelled with no slots'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname]

set_value.name: $opName
set_value.exact: if typeof $op == datatype.table then @$op.$op else null

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s cannot edit slot %s: no entry'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $op.$uid]
'SmartMinelayer: %s slot %s moved: %s items kept, %s to collect as %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $op.$uid, $keptItems.keys.count, $collectItems.keys.count, @$newUid]
'SmartMinelayer: %s deleted slot %s, collect %s, %s left'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $op.$uid, $cutCollect, this.$SmartMinelayerSlotIds.count]
'SmartMinelayer: %s ignored op %s for slot %s (listed at %s of %s), macro %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $opName, @$op.$uid, $opIdx, $slotIds.count, @this.$SmartMinelayerDeployableMacro]

'SmartMinelayer: %s %s slot %s: %s positions in %s, threshold %s, kept items %s, restock at other factions %s, low attention %s, mine %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $opName, $applyEntry.$uid, $applyEntry.$positions.count, @$applyEntry.$sector.debugname, $applyEntry.$threshold, $applyEntry.$items.keys.count, @this.$SmartMinelayerRestockNpc, @this.$SmartMinelayerLowAttention, @this.$SmartMinelayerMineStats]
'SmartMinelayer: %s config returned no slots'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname]

do_if.value: @this.$SmartMinelayerSurplus gt 0 and (not this.$SmartMinelayerSurplusNext? or this.$SmartMinelayerSurplusNext le player.age)

$collectFound and this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.deployable.free lt 1 and this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.deployable.capacity gt 0 and (not this.$SmartMinelayerSurplusNext? or this.$SmartMinelayerSurplusNext le player.age)

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s has no free deployable storage, %s aboard, %s of it claimed items to collect make room for'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.deployable.count, $freeRoomClaims]

do_if.value: not $collectFound and this.$SmartMinelayerSurplus? and this.$SmartMinelayerSurplus le 0

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s has no slots and nothing left to collect, standing by'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s could not restock %s after %s tries'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $deployableMacro, this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]

'SmartMinelayer: %s restocking %s of %s, missing %s of %s, free storage %s, try %s of 5'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockAmount, $deployableMacro, $restockMissing, $restockPositions, $restockFreeStorage, this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]
'SmartMinelayer: %s has no free deployable storage for %s, try %s of 5'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $deployableMacro, this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]
'SmartMinelayer: %s skips %s, %s Cr for one %s, money %s Cr'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockLoc.debugname, $restockUnitPrice / 1Cr, $deployableMacro, player.money / 1Cr]

'SmartMinelayer: %s found no known station or supply ship with the resources for %s of %s that it can pay for, money %s Cr, try %s of 5'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockAmount, $deployableMacro, player.money / 1Cr, this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]

'SmartMinelayer: %s found no known station or supply ship with the resources for %s of %s, other factions\' stations %s, try %s of 5'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockAmount, $deployableMacro, if @this.$SmartMinelayerRestockNpc == 1 then 'allowed' else 'not allowed', this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]
'SmartMinelayer: %s restocks %s of %s at %s, %s Cr each'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockLocAmount, $deployableMacro, $restockSupplier.debugname, $restockUnitPrice / 1Cr]
'SmartMinelayer: %s could not dock at %s to restock'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockSupplier.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s has no free deployable storage for %s at %s, try %s of 5'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $deployableMacro, $restockSupplier.debugname, this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]
'SmartMinelayer: %s cannot pay %s Cr for one %s at %s, money %s Cr'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockUnitPrice / 1Cr, $deployableMacro, $restockSupplier.debugname, player.money / 1Cr]

'SmartMinelayer: %s lost %s as supplier while docked: %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockSupplier.debugname, if @this.assignedcontrolled.dock.container != $restockSupplier then 'no longer docked there' else $restockLocWhy]
'SmartMinelayer: %s could not pay %s Cr at %s, paid %s Cr, refunded'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockPrice / 1Cr, $restockSupplier.debugname, $restockPaid / 1Cr]

'SmartMinelayer: %s restocked %s of %s at %s for %s Cr (%s each), now %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $restockAmount, $deployableMacro, $restockSupplier.debugname, $restockPrice / 1Cr, $restockUnitPrice / 1Cr, this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.{$deployableMacro}.count]
'SmartMinelayer: %s deploying position %s of slot %s in %s, %s left'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $takeK, $takeUid, $placingSector.debugname, $takeEntry.$missing.count]

'SmartMinelayer: %s collecting %s of %s in %s, %s left there, free storage %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $collectObj.debugname, $collectUid, $placingSector.debugname, $collectEntry.$items.keys.count, this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.deployable.free]
'SmartMinelayer: %s cannot reach %s past the military blacklist'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $placingSector.debugname]

'SmartMinelayer: %s cannot reach %s, %s away, queued again'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, if @$collectObj then $collectObj.debugname else 'position %s of slot %s'.[$takeK, $takeUid], this.assignedcontrolled.distanceto.[$placingSector, $standPosition]]
'SmartMinelayer: %s position %s of slot %s was reassigned in flight, skipped'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $takeK, $takeUid]
'SmartMinelayer: %s deployed %s at position %s of slot %s, %s left'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $deployedObj.debugname, $takeK, $takeUid, $takeEntry.$missing.count]
'SmartMinelayer: %s failed to launch %s at position %s of slot %s, queued again'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $deployableMacro, $takeK, $takeUid]

do_if.value: typeof $collectEntry != datatype.table or not $collectObj.exists or @$collectEntry.$inFlight.{$collectObj} != this.assignedcontrolled

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s lost %s of %s while flying to it, skipped'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, @$collectObj.debugname, $collectUid]

'SmartMinelayer: %s collected %s of %s, %s left there, now %s aboard, surplus %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $collectObj.debugname, $collectUid, $collectEntry.$items.keys.count, this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.{$deployableMacro}.count, this.$SmartMinelayerSurplus]

'SmartMinelayer: %s failed to collect %s of %s, free storage %s, tried again in 10 min'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $collectObj.debugname, $collectUid, this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.deployable.free]
'SmartMinelayer: %s collected the last item of %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $collectUid]
'SmartMinelayer: %s has no %s aboard to return, surplus %s dropped'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $deployableMacro, this.$SmartMinelayerSurplus]

'SmartMinelayer: %s found no known station that builds %s and takes back %s of it, other factions\' stations %s, next try in 10 min'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $deployableMacro, $retAmount, if @this.$SmartMinelayerRestockNpc == 1 then 'allowed' else 'not allowed']

'SmartMinelayer: %s frees room at %s (%s): up to %s of %s for %s claimed items to collect, other deployables it builds'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $retStation.debugname, if $retStation.isplayerowned then 'own' else 'other faction', [$freeRoomClaims, $retLocAmount].min, $deployableMacro, $freeRoomClaims]

'SmartMinelayer: %s returns %s of %s to %s (%s), %s Cr each'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $retLocAmount, $deployableMacro, $retStation.debugname, if $retStation.isplayerowned then 'own' else 'other faction', $retUnitPrice / 1Cr]
'SmartMinelayer: %s could not dock at %s to return its surplus, next try in 10 min'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $retStation.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s lost %s as surplus taker while docked, next try in 10 min'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $retStation.debugname]

do_if.value: not this.$SmartMinelayerSurplusNext? or this.$SmartMinelayerSurplusNext le player.age

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s freed no deployable storage at %s, next try in 10 min'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, @$retStation.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s docks at %s to wait'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $refuge.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s waits at %s in %s, field radius %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $parkPosition, $parkSector.debugname, $parkRadius]

do_if.value: @this.assignedcontrolled.commander and ((not @this.$SmartMinelayerSlotIds.count and @this.assignedcontrolled.commanderentity.$SmartMinelayerSlotIds.count gt 0) or (not @this.$SmartMinelayerDeployableMacro and @this.assignedcontrolled.commanderentity.$SmartMinelayerCollectIds.count gt 0))

($collectFound and this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.deployable.free ge 1) or ((@this.$SmartMinelayerSurplus gt 0 or ($collectFound and this.assignedcontrolled.ammostorage.deployable.capacity gt 0)) and (not this.$SmartMinelayerSurplusNext? or this.$SmartMinelayerSurplusNext le player.age))

debug_text.text: 'SmartMinelayer: %s synced %s: %s slots, %s alive, %s in flight, %s missing, refill slot %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, $syncCaller, $slotIds.count, $syncAlive, $syncFlight, $syncMissing, $workUid]
'SmartMinelayer: %s order removed, state cleared'.[@this.assignedcontrolled.debugname]
'SmartMinelayer: %s order stopped, current order %s'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, @this.assignedcontrolled.order.id]
'SmartMinelayer: %s restock try cut short by order %s, not counted, %s left'.[this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.order.id, 5 - this.$SmartMinelayerRestock.$tries]
